# Automated fixtures

These PDFs and images are synthetic fixtures generated by `build_fixtures.py`.

They support deterministic automated regression and visual checks. They are not customer documents and must be reported as `AUTOMATED FIXTURE PASS`, not `REAL DOCUMENT PASS`.

Files:

- `native_three_pages.pdf`: three visually distinct pages with embedded CJK text.
- `image_placement.pdf`: one placed image plus non-target page content.
- `scanned_candidate.pdf`: image-only classification fixture.
- `image_original.png` / `image_replacement.png`: different content, dimensions and aspect ratios.
